description: This file defines the ContextAuthenticationException class, which is a custom exception used within the OpenMRS API to represent authentication-related errors when a user attempts unauthorized service or object access.

classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, used to indicate authentication issues within the OpenMRS API.
